About

Muhammad Subhan

I’m a Pakistani student living in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. I completed my IGCSEs at Al-Rowad International Schools, where I now study Mathematics, Physics and Computer Science at International A Level. I expect to finish in 2028.

Aviation was one of my first interests. Studying crew management and aircraft design made me curious about the decisions and coordination behind a flight. I’ve since explored business and technology through short courses and events in Riyadh.
